title: Surreal Cosmic Oracle
description: A large transparent crystal sphere rests on a golden stand above a calm sea. Inside the orb, a glowing red eye with blue cosmic patterns floats above a vibrant pink lotus, with a white-robed figure standing on desert dunes below and a translucent female figure on the right connected by flowing energy lines.
prompt: A large transparent crystal sphere on a golden stand floating above a calm sea under a dramatic sky with dark clouds and sun rays. Inside the orb is a surreal scene featuring a large glowing red eye with blue cosmic patterns at the top, a vibrant pink lotus flower in the center, a white-robed figure standing on orange desert dunes at the bottom, and a translucent glowing female figure on the right with flowing energy tendrils connecting to the lotus. Shattered glass fragments float around the sphere.
